bugs.title: Intermittent "Error 102" bricked state
bugs.symptom: The SiWx917 would drop into a timed-out, unresponsive state during development with no clear trigger.
bugs.fix: Learned to recognize the symptom early and recover with a J-Link mass-erase and reflash instead of debugging downstream effects.

bugs.title: Datasheet I2C pins dead on silicon
bugs.symptom: Pins 54 and 55, listed as valid I2C pins, produced no bus activity on our board.
bugs.cause: The silicon did not match the datasheet pin assignment.
bugs.fix: Confirmed alternates on a logic analyzer, rerouted the bus to pins 6 and 7 with firmware reconfiguration and bodge wires.

bugs.title: Camera pulling the sensor bus to 5 V
bugs.symptom: The ArduCam OV2640 ships with onboard pull-ups that tie SDA and SCL to 5 V.
bugs.cause: The SHT41 and VEML7700 sharing the bus are 3.3 V parts and cannot tolerate 5 V.
bugs.fix: Moved the camera to a second SiWx917 board on its own I2C segment, which became the two-board architecture.

bugs.title: 5 V rail would not come up
bugs.symptom: On one assembled board the TPS63802 rail stayed down under any load; an identical second board worked.
bugs.cause: A faulty boost IC, not a layout or design defect.
bugs.fix: Replaced the IC. Bringing up two boards in parallel is what made the difference between a part defect and a design defect visible.

bugs.title: Fan running weak and inconsistent
bugs.symptom: The original high-side switch never fully enhanced the MOSFET.
bugs.cause: Insufficient gate drive in the high-side topology.
bugs.fix: Reworked to a low-side AO3400A N-channel driver, giving clean on/off and PWM control.

bugs.title: SDK 3.5.2 to 4.0.0 silent failures
bugs.symptom: Wi-Fi and peripherals failed without errors after the WiseConnect upgrade; one flashing failure bricked a board.
bugs.cause: Incorrect feature bit maps, renamed APIs and changed join-callback signatures.
bugs.fix: Worked from release notes and example projects, recovered the board with a J-Link mass-erase, and audited CMSIS-RTOS2 stack and priority settings.

bugs.title: MQTT racing ahead of Wi-Fi association
bugs.symptom: The MQTT task tried to connect before the network was up.
bugs.cause: No synchronization between Wi-Fi join and the MQTT task.
bugs.fix: Added a Wi-Fi-up event group that gates the MQTT task, and iterated on OTA chunk handling and post-update reboot.
